title: Donatella Versace and REVOLVE Group Announce Beauty-and-Fashion Joint Venture
description: Donatella will serve as Chief Creative Officer of the independent venture, which plans to begin with beauty; its consumer-facing name, final legal structure and exact commercial launch timing remain undisclosed.

title: Court rejects Google ad-tech breakup, orders behavioural remedies
description: AdX and DFP face interoperability, rival-access and publisher-data obligations, while structural divestiture was rejected and implementation remains pending.

title: Google Adds Live Avatar to Gemini Enterprise
description: Gemini 3.8 Live can now respond through synchronized generated video personas in Gemini Enterprise, while custom avatar creation remains restricted to allowlisted organisations.

title: Meta launches Meta One subscription family across Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp
description: Optional plans add app features and expanded Meta AI usage while core Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp services remain free.

title: OpenAI Formalises Framework for Reporting Model-Misalignment Incidents
description: The company published six initial examples from training and evaluation environments alongside a standing process for investigating and disclosing qualifying cases.

title: US states settle antitrust challenge to proposed Paramount–Warner Bros. Discovery deal
description: The proposed consent decree still requires court approval, while a separate WGA settlement resolves another legal challenge and the acquisition itself remains proposed.

title: KALLAX Storageborn Makes IKEA’s Storage Logic Playable in Skyrim
description: The IKEA Skyrim Creation builds on familiar follower inventory, turning KALLAX’s real-world storage role into visible, playable behaviour.

title: Listen to What Mur Mur’s Tiny Worlds Are Doing
description: oio × Mattering’s mur mur links three simulated environments to an evolving ambient soundscape. The thing to notice is not just what you hear, but what is happening in the world while you hear it.

title: Look at What the Letters Are Attached To
description: Kwazi Design’s Type Around Town documents Kolkata lettering with the buses, shopfronts, plaques and facades that carry it, then sometimes isolates those forms for comparison. The result is a reason to look not only at the letters, but at what they belong to.

title: Look Between the Islands
description: At the Walker Art Center, Olalekan Jeyifous’s Hydricosmic Litanies arranges platforms, fragments, wall works, sound and moving image as parts of one riverine field. The useful place to look is between them.

title: What an Architectural Model Lets You See
description: At Jia Curated’s Architecture in Scale, Elok House shows how one maquette can make spatial relationships easier to inspect, while project documentation explains the intentions behind some of those decisions.

title: What Australia’s Under-16 Social Media Numbers Actually Measure
description: Platform account actions, reported account holding and actual use are different measures. Australia’s early evidence supports each with a different level of confidence.

title: The Gateway Is Moving. The News Brand Is Harder to Measure.
description: News discovery is becoming more intermediated across many markets. But distribution, source recognition, trust, habit and payment do not move together.

title: The WPP–Publicis Gap Is Easier to Measure Than Explain
description: On the closest comparable growth measures, Publicis has outpaced WPP since 2022. The evidence points to layered contributors—account dynamics, business mix and organisation—not a single AI or strategy explanation.

title: Earning More Is Not the Same as Being Resilient
description: England’s 15 DCMS-sponsored museums and galleries have become more reliant on self-generated income. The shift is not straightforward commercialisation, but a harder question about what each income source actually contributes to resilience and public purpose.

title: Walmart Doesn’t Need to Own the Whole Media Chain
description: Walmart is buying selected media layers while making its audiences and commerce-linked measurement usable through external tools and inventory. The more useful question is not whether the system is open or closed, but what remains Walmart’s as access expands.

title: When Media Carries Claims About Its Own History
description: Provenance can add a signed record of claims about how media was created and changed. That gives us more evidence to inspect without deciding what—or whom—to believe.

title: Who Owns the Song Is Only Part of the Question
description: Music rights can now move through investment vehicles, debt structures and secondary sales while administration, licensing and catalogue development remain specialised functions. Understanding control increasingly means looking beyond the economic owner alone.
